demography.title: Demography
demography.populationDescription: Population on 1 January for Georgia, its 11 regions and 64 municipalities, with density by region.
demography.ageSexDescription: The age and sex structure of the population.
demography.ageSexMetaDescription: Georgia’s population by age group and sex, {first}–{last}, and the census age structure of each region, from Geostat data.
demography.migrationMetaDescription: People who moved to Georgia and left it, by citizenship, and net migration, {first}–{last}, from Geostat data.
demography.birthsDeathsDescription: Births, deaths, fertility and life expectancy.
demography.birthsDeathsMetaDescription: Registered births and deaths in Georgia, {first}–{last}, with fertility and life expectancy, from Geostat data.
demography.mapCensusNote: From 2025 the figures are based on the 2024 census, and maps for 2024 and 2025 are not comparable, so the map shows the latest year only.
demography.densityNote: Density is the 1 January population divided by one fixed area as of March 2014, occupied territories excluded. Tbilisi is {area} km² in Geostat's convention, not the 726 km² often cited.
demography.placeMetaDescription: {name}: population on 1 January, {first}–{last}, births and deaths, and the census age and sex structure, from Geostat data.
demography.placeMunicipalityMetaDescript: {name}, {region}: population on 1 January, {first}–{last}, and births and deaths, from Geostat data.
demography.censusNote: On 1 January 2025 Geostat re-based the population to the 2024 census, adding about {count} people. Figures before and after are on different bases and are not compared.
demography.source: Source: Geostat — population on 1 January and density by region, {start}–{end}. Shares and ranks are computed by Fiscal.ge.
demography.highlightsNote: The indicators describe this place for the last year of the period. No change is computed: from 2025 the figures are based on the 2024 census.
demography.migrationGroupsNote: "Other countries" is every other citizenship, stateless persons, not stated and Geostat's own Other, added up by Fiscal.ge
demography.rowAriaCompare: {age}: men {men}, women {women}, total {total} ({share}); {year}: men {cmpMen}, women {cmpWomen}, total {cmpTotal} ({cmpShare})
demography.heroBalanced: As many people arrived as left.
demography.migrationIndicatorsNote: The indicators describe the last year of the period for the chosen sex and all citizenships. Foreign citizens are all arrivals except citizens of Georgia.
demography.migrationSource: Source: Geostat — immigrants and emigrants by sex and citizenship, and net migration, {start}–{end} (Ministry of Internal Affairs border records). "Other countries", the net migration of selected groups and the foreign citizens' share are computed by Fiscal.ge.

demography.vitalDeathsSince: Deaths have outnumbered births every year since {year}.
demography.vitalDeathsWholeSeries: Deaths have outnumbered births in every year on record, {first}–{last}.
demography.vitalEven: Births and deaths were equal in {year}.
demography.vitalSource: Source: Geostat, live births and deaths by region and self-governed unit, {first}–{last}. Counts are registered events and do not change at the census re-base.
demography.vitalCompare: Compare all places, and see fertility and life expectancy →
demography.asfrLabel: Births per 1,000 women, by mother's age
demography.asfrNote: The youngest and oldest groups (under 20, 45–54) are as Geostat publishes them. Rates use the population of women as the denominator, so from 2025 they rest on the 2024 census.
demography.asfrChartName: Births per 1,000 women by mother's age, one line per year, {first}–{last}
demography.ratioMapNote: Under 100: more people died than were born. The ratio uses registered counts and does not change at the census re-base.

demography.marriageRatesNote: Rates per 1,000 residents are calculated by Fiscal.ge from Geostat's counts and its mid-year population, the method of Geostat's own crude rates.
